about_the_game:
The life of a city sewer rat is a continuous cycle of misfortune and hardship. As the lowest rung in the urban ecosystem, everything in the city poses a threat. Starving stray cats, sudden sewer floods, and crows waiting to strike from the shadows… But of all these dangers, the most terrifying of them all is undoubtedly "humans."

Here, too, the lives of one sewer rat family have been filled with suffering. This month has been particularly cruel—they have barely had a scrap of food to eat. But perhaps this, too, shall pass. After all, nothing remains miserable forever, does it? A luxurious feast unfolds before their eyes.

…But some misfortunes are eternal. When the protagonist sewer rat finally returns, what awaits is a scene of tragedy—his family, cold and lifeless, having consumed poisoned food. In the depths of his despair, a cockroach appears and casually begins feasting on the very same poisoned meal. As the protagonist watches this unsettling sight, a single, dreadful plan takes root in his mind…

The sewer rat’s plan will not be easy. He had barely managed to keep his family from starving—how can he now evade all manner of obstacles and acquire high-quality food in large enough quantities to satisfy his newfound partners, the renowned gourmet cockroaches? There will be troublemakers stirring up the trash, destroying food, and even attacking the protagonist himself. The gourmet cockroaches’ tastes will only grow more refined. The sewer rat’s stamina is limited, and as time goes on, he must make decisions faster than ever.

Now, his fate is in your hands. Can his story end in a happy ending?

name: Rusty Foodies

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64.
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers.

short_description: Rusty Foodies is a puzzle game where you must strategically place various food blocks according to specific rules to achieve the target score. As you progress through the stages, you'll face an increasing number of obstacles, making placement more challenging.
